query.intent: Validation of the tolerance argument in the as-of merge operation (merge_asof) raises a ValueError when the tolerance is negative, with a message saying it must be positive. Change the message text to say non-negative.
query.symptom: The merge_asof error message for a negative tolerance says the value must be positive, even though zero is allowed.

history.analysis: The `_AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance` method in pandas/core/reshape/merge.py raises MergeError("tolerance must be positive") in three branches: datetimelike, integer and float. Each of them accepts zero, so the message should read "non-negative". The tests at ids 51058 and 29433 match on the old message, so they will need updating too.
